file: Self-checking and fault-tolerant digital design (Lala, Parag K., 1948-) .pdf
citation: P. K. Lala, "Self-Checking and Fault-Tolerant Digital Design", Morgan Kaufmann, 2001
title: Self-Checking and Fault-Tolerant Digital Design

segments.title: Front matter
segments.why: The chapter is front matter without arithmetic-unit or error-checking design detail.

segments.title: Fundamentals of Reliability
segments.why: The chapter presents general reliability and failure-rate analysis rather than an arithmetic-unit or checker mechanism.

segments.title: Error Detecting and Correcting Codes
segments.why: The chapter defines error-detecting codes, including residue and Berger codes that underpin the corresponding concurrent-checking families.

segments.title: Self-Checking Combinational Logic Design
segments.why: The chapter develops self-checking combinational circuits and applies coded-output checking to arithmetic logic, including residue-protected ALUs.

segments.title: Self-Checking Checkers
segments.why: The chapter describes tree-structured two-rail checkers and totally self-checking Berger-code checkers.

segments.title: Self-Checking Sequential Circuit Design
segments.why: The chapter concerns self-checking finite-state and sequential-control circuits rather than arithmetic units or their checkers.

segments.title: Fault-Tolerant Design
segments.why: The chapter describes hardware replication and temporal redundancy as fault-tolerant checking and recovery mechanisms.

segments.title: Markov Models
segments.why: The appendix explains Markov reliability models without describing an arithmetic-unit or checker implementation.

segments.title: Index
segments.why: The chapter is an index rather than substantive design material.
